hostPolicy.decision: Initial product scope is Apple Silicon only, with final macOS 15.0 as the runtime minimum and final macOS 26.5 SDK as the build baseline.

experimentalCell.physicalUSB: macOS 27 SDK inspection requires --experimental-usb; not part of the final product baseline.
experimentalCell.scope: Existing P01/P00 local tests and SDK-header audits only. This beta host and RC toolchain cannot serve as final minimum-host or signed release qualification.

releaseTestingHostPolicy.meaning: Eligibility permits release testing only. It does not imply a compatible or qualified guest/product matrix. Build-host requirements are separate; minimum-host tests may run an already signed artifact built elsewhere.
releaseTestingHostPolicy.minimumHost15Eligibility: Pending independently verified exact public 15.0 build tuple. releaseTestingHostPolicy.rejection: Any tuple not explicitly reviewed is rejected, including current macOS27.0 build26A5425a and unreviewed suffix-free final-looking builds.
releaseTestingHostPolicy.workflowIntegration: Strict checks precede release-candidate physical-confirmation publication, long qualification and local scripts/release.sh public preflight. Workflow receipts are retained as artifacts; the local preflight prints host/SDK receipts before build work.

remainingPhysicalQualification: Build the exact source with final Xcode26.6/SDK26.5 on a final supported build host.
Exercise all declared native/VZ lifecycle paths on physical Apple Silicon running the final macOS15.0 minimum and a current final macOS release.
Qualify exact compatible guest restore images and runtime saved-state continuation in P08.

cellProfiles.scope: One-vCPU initial profile; interpreter/baseline-JIT modes are separate results. SMP is a later separately revised P07 profile.

existingHarnessAudit.scope: Destructive dedicated-clean-account container-engine qualification; requires explicit confirmation token and pinned images. Never execute in this user account and never treat as whole-VM evidence.
Historical exploratory container/shared-VM comparison. Mutable default tags and ad-hoc fixtures mean outputs cannot become candidate-bound P14 evidence.

Existing verified-counter microbenchmark with matched native/minimal-HV/Dory paths, five rounds, two warmups, twenty samples, <=3 percent overhead and >=95 percent host-native throughput. Probe-client evidence only, not production desktop/workload performance.
Host storage baseline collection; not guest durable block-device performance.
Host/network baseline collection; not automatically the VM NAT/device path.

Existing schema1 validator enforces ARM64 Linux and rejects provisional qualification. It cannot yet represent translated x86 or Mac results; extend/review the schema under P14 before promoting their evidence.

fixtureIdentityRequirements: Before collection, pin guest image/ISO/IPSW and installed-disk manifest, kernel/libc/graphics stack, workload source+binary, compiler/options, firmware/renderer/tools and reference VMM by exact digest/revision.
Do not measure a mutable :latest container or unversioned npm/apt result.
A missing required guest, reference, instrumentation or capability is unavailable/fail for that gate, never a zero-duration success.
freezeProcedure: Collect baseline calibration on the final physical host/resource matrix, with complete correctness and attribution.
Assign final numeric bounds for every applicable cell/profile and pin the workload list, sampling plan, fixture digests, baseline evidence and independent review.
Commit a frozen revision before running the candidate; never adjust a threshold simply to pass a failing candidate.
Any subsequent host/guest/profile/workload/budget change records rationale and invalidates/requalifies affected cells.

performancePolicy.relationshipToPlan: P14.B targets remain the governing initial targets. This receipt defines concrete workload boundaries and initial memory/shutdown/reclamation caps before optimization; it does not replace P14 qualification.
remainingReleaseGates: No P00 three-cell performance samples collected.
Initial memory/GPU/DBT/shutdown/reclamation limits are uncalibrated engineering choices.

macOS/x86 evidence schema and whole-product measurement harnesses remain P14 work.

sampling.clocks: Host monotonic end-to-end intervals, or explicitly calibrated clock domains; never subtract unsynchronized guest and host timestamps.
sampling.invalidSamples: Keep failure reasons/raw observations; timeout is a failure, retry never erases an observation.
sampling.runOrder: balanced randomized/interleaved Dory and reference; record seed and actual order
sampling.summary: Retain individual samples, round medians and confidence intervals. Duration targets use independent-round medians; tail metrics require the stated per-round sample minima.
sampling.warmup: two warmups per warm microbenchmark round, recorded and excluded by predeclared policy; cold boot has no warmup substitution

budgets.rationale: P14.B initial installed-boot targets; guest readiness and display completion are both required.

workloads.coldState: Fresh disposable clone of the same pinned installed image, VM stopped; reboot the dedicated host between cold rounds. Record filesystem cache controls; warm rounds are separate.
workloads.definition: From daemon acceptance of a cold-start request for the stopped installed disk to a guest-authenticated ready marker and first complete usable desktop frame. No installer, first-login setup, disk repair or restored memory.

budgets.rationale: Initial engineering usability budget, allowing a larger translated-execution margin; calibrate before candidate judgement.

workloads.definition: From guest shutdown acceptance to guest poweroff, durable disk flush completion, helper exits and resource release.

budgets.rationale: P14.B native microbenchmark target; valid only where host/guest code semantics match.
P14.B maximum native orchestration overhead target.

workloads.definition: Pinned integer, branch and floating-point kernels with verified result digests and equivalent compiler/options in host-native, minimal native HV/VZ and Dory execution contexts.

budgets.rationale: P14.B same-guest native workload overhead target.
P14.B translated ambition only, using identical full-system guest image/resources on the same Apple Silicon host.
No translated key workload more than 10 percent slower than its pinned full-system reference.

workloads.definition: Build a pinned portable C/C++ source tree without network dependencies, compress/decompress a pinned 256 MiB corpus, and run a pinned language-runtime benchmark. Check build output tests and corpus hashes. Each workload is a separate key metric.
workloads.referenceRequirement: A qualified minimal/native same-host reference for native cells; a separately pinned full-system translated reference for x86. Physical x86 is an architectural reference, never a same-host performance denominator.

budgets.rationale: P14.B 1080p60 target; intentional idle frames are excluded by a predeclared rule.
P14.B tail target; no estimate from a handful of frames.
P14.B 60 Hz missed-deadline target; timestamp tolerance is fixed before measurement.

workloads.definition: Continuously demanded updates at 1920x1080, fixed scale and 60 Hz: scroll a pinned local document, move/resize windows and render a deterministic verified scene. Retain completed presentation timestamps and renderer-selection evidence.
workloads.requiredProfile: Declare and retain the exact effective graphics profile. Software, VirGL2, Venus and VZ Mac graphics results remain separate.

budgets.rationale: P14.B input target, not daemon IPC or guest receipt latency.
P14.B input tail target.

workloads.definition: Inject a timestamped key or pointer event that changes a unique visible guest marker; measure host injection to verified completed presentation of that marker.

budgets.rationale: P14.B normal desktop resize target.

workloads.definition: Drive a fixed alternating size sequence. Measure the final resize event to a nonstale completed frame with the requested guest resolution and scale.

budgets.rationale: P14.B idle desktop target; process CPU is summed, not divided by total host core count.
P14.B headless target; not applicable to a Mac desktop guest.

workloads.definition: Leave the guest idle after five minutes of stabilization, with no scheduled benchmark work. Measure attributable CPU over a sixty-second window, retaining all daemon/runner/worker CPU counters.

budgets.rationale: P14.B comparable storage throughput target; exclude guest-cache bandwidth.
P14.B maximum p95 storage regression at matched queue depth.

workloads.correctness: Readback hashes and durability policy must match; any mismatch fails irrespective of speed.
workloads.definition: On a disposable 64 GiB virtual disk backed by the same host volume, run a 4 GiB verified sequential read/write corpus and 4 KiB random operations at queue depths 1 and 16. Include 4 KiB writes followed by guest fsync and a final durable flush. Match cache and persistence semantics to the reference.

budgets.rationale: P14.B comparable network throughput target.
P14.B maximum p95 latency regression at matched concurrency.

workloads.definition: Run guest-to-host and host-to-guest TCP transfer, fixed-size UDP datagrams, and request/reply round trips on a controlled local network path. Pin MTU 1500, concurrency 1 and 4, offload state and endpoint binaries; do not use internet speed as a VMM measure.

budgets.rationale: New provisional per-profile host overhead caps, excluding separately measured resident guest RAM, GPU allocations and DBT cache; not calibrated results.
Provisional 1080p60 profile cap; 4K and multiple displays need separate resource classes.
Provisional translated-code-cache cap, independently attributed.
Provisional grace period for owned VM mappings, vCPU threads, workers and handles to return to the pre-launch baseline.

workloads.definition: Measure the full attributable process set, guest resident memory, graphics allocations and DBT code cache during the fixed compute/desktop/storage workload, then stop. Shared mappings must be deduplicated; if attribution is unavailable, report unavailable.
postStopChecks: No live owned vCPU or worker.
Guest mappings and device grants revoked.
Owned FD and thread counts return to baseline.
Retained framework caches are reported explicitly and cannot be called released VM memory.

budgets.rationale: P14.B correctness is a prerequisite, not a performance tradeoff.
P14.B reliability target for every required workload.

workloads.definition: Every performance sample retains completion, output checksum, expected machine/profile and cleanup results. A retry is a separate observation.

verification.result: 19 distinct tests passed with no skips: five SDK fixture tests, one explicitly selected SDK integration test, thirteen public-host/local-release policy tests. Five modified workflow shell steps and scripts/release.sh parsed. Seven new source-only preflight methods first reproduced the missing local gates; final tests reject RC Xcode, beta/Intel hosts, missing/unreviewed SDKs and missing GIC headers. Existing required missing-SDK and current-beta controls failed as expected; experimental capture remains ineligible. No final-Xcode build or guest performance pass claimed.
